items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, it turned out to be Bill Haley and the Comets.

ctx.x: And this was a venue that usually presented jazz? I mean, you think of an audience that is used to patronizing a certain venue and it seems like the audience for you and the audience for Bill Haley and the Comets . . .
Yeah, it turned out to be Bill Haley and the Comets.
